title: Free After Effects Alternatives
caption:
Free After Effects alternatives that are actually good in 2026. Two of them only became free this year.

Swipe for what each one is best at.

Cavalry: free for every Canva account since April 2026. Best for 2D and procedural motion graphics.
Autograph by Maxon: free since April, and free for commercial teams since May. Motion graphics and compositing in one app.
Fusion: the node compositor built into the free DaVinci Resolve. Titles, compositing and VFX.
Blender: free and open source. The one for 3D.

Save this before your next Adobe renewal, and send it to the friend who's still paying for After Effects.

Which one would you switch to first, and why?
